notes.title: Player Movement Correction and Minor Adjustments
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Light the Backrooms"!

[h2]Update Details:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed movement issues for the player.
[*] Adjusted lighting and exposure settings.
[*] Made various minor tweaks.
[/list]
I would greatly appreciate your feedback and thoughts in a review!

notes.title: Difficulty level has been adjusted
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing "Light the Backrooms"!
We have made the following adjustments

[list]
[*] The previous difficulty level of "Normal" has been changed to "Hard".
[*] The previous difficulty level of "Hard" was changed to "Very Hard".
[*] Added new difficulty levels "Normal" and "A Bit Easy".
[/list]

We would appreciate your feedback through reviews and comments.

notes.title: Simplified Chinese is now supported
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing "Light the Backrooms"!!
The game is now available in Simplified Chinese.
